Dear Tumblr,

TW: Fat shaming, eating disorders, restricting, disabilities, overexercising.

Today started as a good day. As you know, I have a history of anorexia, but this morning I was able to quiet Ana and managed to eat breakfast. Normally this isn't possible, and I know I still need to eat more, but I think 8 eggs, 2 packs of bacon, 10 has browns, and some takeaway that my roommate left from last night was a good step towards fighting my restriction habits. Usually I can barely manage half of that. I'm sure my roomie won't mind I took her food. It was for the cause of mental health.

With my body fueled for once, I began my day. While I managed to temporarily overcome my starvation tendencies, you just can't ask for everything. My exercise addiction persisted and so I walked all the way from my door to the car. I really hate this life sometimes. I just want to be normal and not be suffering from these horrible, unhealthy compulsions. I intended to go to the gym, because you know that one session of exercise is never enough to make the voice go away, but I guess due to the constant brain fog, I found myself at the mall. One day when I'm free maybe I'll stop losing time like this.

At the mall, I decided to confront one of my biggest fears: the food court. I know, I know, I should just stay away. No good comes from going there. I will just be that person with an empty table watching all the normal people get to eat comfortably. In a feat of bravery and resistance, I decided to get something to eat. After all, I had such a win that morning at breakfast so I should reward myself. I had two buffets, but they were so small, you guys. The looks I got ... I imagine people just couldn't imagine someone eating that little!

So there I was, having had one of the best days in the struggle against mental illness, when what do I see, but the personification of the unrealistic beauty standards and impossibly thin models that caused this horrible disorder for me and millions of others in the first place. I see this disgusting skinny bitch just acting like her presence isn't triggering casualties of starvation by the minute. You can just tell when someone is thin because of genetics and not starvation, and what does she do? She sits at my table! She doesn't even ask permission or anything, just plops down, complete with food begins eating right in front of me as if to deliberately torture me. All of a sudden, she bursts out laughing. Apparently there was something on her phone, but I think we all know she was secretly recording me like these types do. My emaciated body must have been too good an opportunity for ridicule to ignore.

There was a conversation about losing your appetite which I didn't hear because in my head I was screaming. Imagine talking about appetite around someone who clearly has issues around this subject? I wanted to be anywhere else. I made a comment that I don't even remember because I didn't want to be as rude as her. How does she respond? She calls me fat, like, just like that, she said "Yeah, I can see, fatty." Then she stands and leaves me there broken.

I'm shaking, you guys. Triggered doesn't even begin to describe it. Any progress I made today was undone in an instant. I ran back to my car and I have been crying ever since. I binged really bad too. I must have spent $300 at the supermarket on the way home. The only consolation is that I didn't purge. I won't let that bitch beat me. I won't succumb to Mia too.

Thanks for listening, everyone.
